description: This file defines the 'BuzzFeedPostModel' class, which implements the 'Normalizable' interface. It wraps a 'BuzzFeedPost' DTO object and provides a method to serialize it into an array form appropriate for API responses. The class includes detailed PHPDoc annotations with OpenAPI schemas for different post types, indicating the structure of various feed post representations (text, photo, video, share).

classes.name: BuzzFeedPostModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes a 'BuzzFeedPost' object into an array matching API schema definitions for various post types in a Buzz feed. Implements 'Normalizable' interface for consistent serialization behavior.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the encapsulated 'BuzzFeedPost' object into an associative array following the API schema. Includes conditional data for video and photo content.
